note: Acquired by KARL STORZ in August 2024; Senhance and LUNA digital surgery IP integrated into KARL STORZ surgical ecosystems.
Acquired Auris Health (founded 2007) in 2019 for $3.4B upfront, adding the MONARCH endoluminal platform and OTTAVA soft-tissue program.
Merged with Intuitive Surgical in 2003, ending litigation and uniting the Zeus and da Vinci patent portfolios.
Reorganized US subsidiary Think Surgical in Fremont, California in 2014 to commercialize ROBODOC / TSolution One and TMINI.
Academic-industry research consortium launched in 2012 repurposing retired first-generation da Vinci hardware supplied by Intuitive.
Collaborated with DePuy Synthes (J&J MedTech) on joint development of the VELYS Active Robotic-Assisted Spine system (2022–2024).
Exclusive global distribution agreement with Olympus for the ROBOPERA flexible endoscopic surgical platform.
Acquired Excelsius Surgical in 2014 to develop and commercialize the ExcelsiusGPS spinal and cranial robotic navigation platform.
Supplies Force Dimension omega.x desktop parallel-kinematic haptic master controllers used to teleoperate the Raven-II research platform.
Supplied dual Force Dimension omega.7 7-DOF haptic master interfaces for the EndoMaster EASE Surgeon Console Unit.
Supplies dual Force Dimension lambda.7 7-DOF haptic master controllers (succeeding earlier omega.7 units) for the EndoQuest ELS physician console.
Supplies dual Force Dimension lambda.7 7-DOF haptic master interfaces for the RIVERFIELD Saroa surgeon console.
Supplies dual Force Dimension sigma.7 7-DOF haptic master controllers for the Virtual Incision MIRA surgeon console.
ROBODOC orthopedic surgical robotics assets and technology lineage acquired by Curexo in 2007.
Original ROBODOC orthopedic surgical robotics technology developed by Integrated Surgical Systems transitioned via Curexo (2007) into US subsidiary Think Surgical (2014).
Supplied endoscopic optics and 3D visualization systems for Computer Motion's Zeus platform.
Supplies 3D TipCam endoscopic visualization hardware for Medtronic's Hugo RAS system.
Strategic investment and commercial integration of KARL STORZ imaging systems with Moon Surgical's Maestro platform.
Supplies the 6-axis high-payload KUKA KR QUANTEC HC robot arm for the CyberKnife radiosurgery platform.
Supplies the 7-axis KUKA LBR Med medical robot arm integrated into Andromeda Surgical's Beacon platform.
Supplies the 7-axis KUKA LBR Med collaborative robotic arm integrated into the eCential Robotics spine navigation platform.
Supplies the 7-axis KUKA LBR Med collaborative medical robot arm for ROPCA's ARTHUR ultrasound scanning system.
Acquired Mako Surgical Corp. (founded 2004) in 2013 for $1.65B to establish Stryker's Mako orthopedic joint replacement division.
Acquired Israeli spine robotics manufacturer Mazor Robotics (founded 2001) in 2018 for $1.64B to anchor Medtronic's Mazor spine portfolio.
Acquired French surgical robotics manufacturer Medtech SA (founded 2002) in 2016 to commercialize the ROSA Brain, Spine, and Knee platforms.
Strategic investment and distribution agreement in September 2026 to commercialize the Sentire RAS system in the UK and select markets outside the US.
Formed the Intbot joint venture in China to manufacture and commercialize the iSR'obot Mona Lisa prostate biopsy system.
Formed the CathBot joint venture in China in 2020 to manufacture and register the R-One vascular robotic system.
Developed the Gemtrack miniature radiofrequency tracking sensor acquired by DePuy Synthes / J&J MedTech for the VELYS platform.
DePuy Synthes acquired French orthopedic robotics developer Orthotaxy in 2018 to develop the VELYS knee platform.
Long-standing 3D endoscope OEM for Intuitive; Intuitive acquired Schölly's robotic endoscope business and manufacturing line in 2019.
Led $400M financing round in April 2026 with exclusive US distribution rights for Versius and a 2028–2029 call option to acquire CMR Surgical.
Licensed single-access surgical robotics patent portfolio to Intuitive in 2023.
Licensed surgical robotics intellectual property to Medtronic prior to 2024 reverse merger with Conavi Medical.
